title: CyberAId WP2 meeting
summary: The meeting focused on the creation and prioritization of requirements using the MoSCoW method, emphasizing the importance of understanding user roles and stories in relation to these requirements. A discussion on architectural considerations was also held, highlighting the integration of various systems and the need for clear documentation and communication moving forward. The meeting focused on establishing a workgroup dedicated to architectural discussions using Slack and GitHub for collaboration. Participants were encouraged to join these platforms to facilitate communication and manage project requirements effectively.
decisions: Requirements will be categorized using the MoSCoW method.
The initial phase will prioritize collecting requirements from pilots and technical partners.
User roles must be identified after the requirements are established.
Drafts related to architecture and integration will be discussed and refined in subsequent meetings.
Create a Slack channel for architectural discussions.
Provide maintainer rights on GitHub to at least one person from each organization.
Utilize GitLab for project management and issue tracking.

action_items.task: Fill in the requirements table based on the requirements discussed.
Provide an email with detailed instructions outlining requirements for each participant.
Discuss initial architectural suggestions and diagrams created by George.
Send an email with detailed instructions on working on requirement collection.
Encourage team members to join GitHub and GitLab.

risks: Potential misalignment on requirement standards among partners.
Incomplete understanding of user roles may lead to insufficient user stories.
Possibility of delays in delivery of requirements, which are expected by June.
open_questions: What feedback or suggestions do participants have regarding the requirement documentation?
What additional details are needed for the architecture discussions going forward?
Clarification on the quantum token package discussed in the next meeting.
